text:
Sam: Heads-up: Ruby SDK appears to behave differently on 429 retries vs other SDKs after recent PR. Anyone triaged?
Olivia: Oh, weird. Which PR? link?
Sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/842
Sam: Repro snippet:
```
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], retry_max: 0)
resp = client.generate(prompt: "hi")
# we see immediate 429 bubble instead of backoff+retry
```
Olivia: That PR changed default retry strategy to be more conservative for rate limits, but didn't change the gem default. Could be we accidentally left `retry_max` unset behavior inconsistent vs python/go.
Michael: CI on the PR shows a failing integration that expects 3 retries on 429: https://ci.redwood/842
Olivia: If that's true it's a semver risk. We should align behavior with other SDKs or ship a patch bumping minor.
Sam: Minimal proposal: restore previous default to 3 for now, add an opt-in config `retry_strategy: :conservative` for the new behavior
Olivia: I'll open a tiny PR to revert default and add a deprecation note in CHANGELOG. @Michael can you review when you have a minute?
Michael: I can review in ~30m :eyes:
CI Bot: CI pipeline finished — ruby-3.1 matrix: failed; ruby-2.7: passed; logs in artifact bundle
Sam: Thanks — created issue #1274 and linked new PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/849
Olivia: Nice, added a test to assert default retry_max == 3 and a changelog entry. Will merge after review. :thumbsup:
Michael: Quick pass done, left a nit on the test name. otherwise LGTM.
Sam: Great, will watch the deploy. If it passes, can we ship a 0.18.1 patch? We need parity across SDKs before next release.
Olivia: Yep planning 0.18.1 today after merge. Notifying release channel.
CI Bot: Merge completed, binary artifacts queued.
Sam: Thanks all!
